observation: Turso replica-reopen trial 2 failed during initial setup when its native sync fetch reported an unexpectedly closed socket, before any reopen measurement.

confirmedFacts.error: sync engine operation failed: database sync engine error: fetch error: TypeError: The socket connection was closed unexpectedly. For more information, pass `verbose: true` in the second argument to fetch()
confirmedFacts.serviceLog: Broken pipe and invalid HTTP request messages; no recorded no-storage-space error in this attempt.
confirmedFacts.containerState: Turso and admin remained running with unchanged recorded start times across the trial.

limitations: The socket error establishes failed transport setup, not why the connection closed.
This failure is not attributed to disk exhaustion or product reopen behavior. Empty outer/client logs do not prove absence of SDK errors.
nextAction: After fixed collection, inspect client/server request-close timing and reproduce setup with verbose transport traces. Preserve the failed attempt without replacement.
